items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a value that is measured in ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS.
items.translation: 创建一个新AggregationExpression，用于计算以ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS为单位的值的双曲正切。

items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a value that is measured in the given unit.
